title: REQ · Poll detects SCHEDULED and CLOSED Rounds through a Git interface
summary: Poll pulls via Git, lists Rounds and returns the SCHEDULED and CLOSED Round IDs
description: Context: no poller exists. Desired behavior: Poller.Poll calls Git.Pull then Git.ListRounds(worldID) and returns Result with Scheduled and Closed ID slices in list order. Expected result: the worker can see which Rounds are waiting to open and which are ready for development. Why: later phases start executions from CLOSED Rounds.
acceptance_criteria: Given Rounds R1 SCHEDULED, R2 OPEN (not expired) and R3 CLOSED, when Poll runs, then Result.Scheduled is [R1] and Result.Closed is [R3].
Given no Rounds, when Poll runs, then Result slices are empty and the error is nil.
Given Poll runs, then Git.Pull is called before Git.ListRounds exactly once each.

in_scope: Round, Status, Git, Clock, Result, Poller, New, Poll detection
